objects.name: _events
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "_events" ("id" TEXT, "source" TEXT, "ty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_at" TEXT, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: fixture
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "fixture" ("id" TEXT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: fixture_child
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "fixture_child" ("id" TEXT, "fixture_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "fixture" ("id"), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
